item.content:encoded:
You have the name for this all wrong. First off, the other Project Proposals have the title of the piece. Secondly, the year isn't the year of creation, it's the year of the expo the piece is being submitted to. Expos are in years ending in -4.

On further consideration, I'm downvoting for this. This is equivalent to someone posting SCP-3245 or Scp 2290. It's an error in the basic template of the format, and so something that must be fixed for the piece to function on the site. This may be a new and experimental format, but it still has rules that your own team laid out.
